# Test fixtures

Small text-based CAD samples (everything else is generated by the tests).

- `cube-10mm.stp`, `cube-10mm.igs` — a 10 × 10 × 10 mm cube, taken from the test files of
  [occt-import-js](https://github.com/kovacsv/occt-import-js) (LGPL-2.1), with the original
  author's name and file path removed from the headers.
